mapper.select: SELECT LED_THRESHOLD as ledThreshold, AUTO_LED_MODE as autoLedMode, MANUAL_LED_THRESHOLD as manualLedThreshold, LOCATION_LAT as locationLat, LOCATION_LNG as locationLng, SLEEP_START_HOUR as sleepStartHour, SLEEP_END_HOUR as sleepEndHour, SLEEP_MODE_ENABLED as sleepModeEnabled, DOOR_OPEN_TEMP as doorOpenTemp, DOOR_CLOSE_TEMP as doorCloseTemp, FAN_HUMIDITY_THRESHOLD as fanHumidityThreshold, FAN_CO2_THRESHOLD as fanCO2Threshold, FAN_CO_THRESHOLD as fanCOThreshold, FAN_SPEED as fanSpeed, TEMP_HIGH_ALERT as tempHighAlert, TEMP_LOW_ALERT as tempLowAlert, HUMIDITY_HIGH_ALERT as humidityHighAlert, HUMIDITY_LOW_ALERT as humidityLowAlert, CO2_ALERT as co2Alert, CO_ALERT as coAlert, NH3_ALERT as nh3Alert, ENV_STATUS_GOOD as envStatusGood, ENV_STATUS_FAIR as envStatusFair FROM ENV_SETTINGS WHERE ID = 1
